---
title: "MATH840 Final project: leaderboard"
from: markdown-smart
format:
  dashboard:
    theme: [cosmo, leaderboard.scss]
    orientation: rows
    include-after-body: leaderboard_link.html
---

```{python}
#| include: false
# One dashboard for the whole project. The public page reads board/public.csv only. The other three pages
# show the hidden hours, so they read nothing until both keys are turned:
#   - board/private.csv exists, which only `project_score.py final` writes (after 21:00 on 5 November);
#   - MATH840_REVEAL=1 is set for the render.
# Before that each card on those pages says when it opens, and the hidden data never enters the HTML.
#
# Tables are plain HTML so that leaderboard_link.html can tie each row to its point in the scatter next
# to it: in every linked scatter, trace 0 holds the students (customdata = name) and the trace with
# meta "pick" is the empty highlight the script fills in.
import html
import json
import os
from datetime import datetime
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import plotly.graph_objects as go
from IPython import get_ipython
from IPython.display import HTML

# Quarto displays every bare expression in a cell; each fig.add_trace(...) would become a figure of its own.
get_ipython().ast_node_interactivity = "last_expr"

PROJECT = Path(os.environ.get("MATH840_PROJECT_DIR", "../grading/project"))
BOARD = PROJECT / "board"
BENCHMARK = "----SNAIVE----"
WEIGHTS = {"RMSE": 0.3, "MAPE": 0.3, "Winkler": 0.4}
REVEAL = os.environ.get("MATH840_REVEAL") == "1" and (BOARD / "private.csv").exists()
WAIT = HTML('<div class="wait">Opens at Session 2, on 6 November.</div>')
NEXT = {"session1": "4 Nov, 09:00", "update1": "5 Nov, 09:00", "update2": "6 Nov, Session 2",
        "final": "6 Nov, Session 2"}

# Ink and marks: one blue for students, a darker step of it for the one in focus, ink for the benchmark.
INK, INK2, MUTED, GRID, RULE, SURFACE = "#0b0b0b", "#52514e", "#898781", "#e1e0d9", "#c3c2b7", "#fcfcfb"
POINT, ACCENT = "#6da7ec", "#1c5cab"
FONT = "Fira Sans, system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, sans-serif"


def look(fig, **layout):
    layout = {"margin": dict(l=64, r=20, t=16, b=64), **layout}
    fig.update_layout(template="none", font=dict(family=FONT, size=13, color=INK2), showlegend=False,
                      paper_bgcolor=SURFACE, plot_bgcolor=SURFACE,
                      hoverlabel=dict(bgcolor="white", bordercolor=RULE, font=dict(family=FONT, color=INK)),
                      **layout)
    axis = dict(showgrid=True, gridcolor=GRID, gridwidth=1, zeroline=False, showline=True, linecolor=RULE,
                ticks="", tickfont=dict(color=MUTED), title_font=dict(color=INK2), automargin=True)
    return fig.update_xaxes(**axis).update_yaxes(**axis)


def show(fig, div_id, lead=""):
    # The lead (subtitle, picker) sits above the plot; the stylesheet lets the plot take the rest of the card.
    body = fig.to_html(full_html=False, include_plotlyjs="cdn", div_id=div_id, default_height="100%",
                       config={"displayModeBar": False, "responsive": True})
    return HTML(lead + body)


def nice_ticks(values) -> list:
    lo, hi = float(np.nanmin(values)) * 0.9, float(np.nanmax(values)) * 1.1
    steps = [v * 10 ** e for e in range(0, 5) for v in (1, 1.5, 2, 3, 5, 7)]
    inside = [t for t in steps if lo <= t <= hi]
    return inside[:: max(1, len(inside) // 6)]


def pick_trace(hover):
    # The highlight the script moves around: empty until a row or a point is hovered.
    return go.Scatter(x=[], y=[], text=[], customdata=[], meta="pick", mode="markers+text",
                      textposition="top center", textfont=dict(color=INK, size=13), cliponaxis=False,
                      marker=dict(size=15, color=ACCENT, line=dict(color=SURFACE, width=2)),
                      hovertemplate=hover)


def students_trace(df, x, y, hover):
    # Plain lists: plotly 6 would ship arrays as base64, which the linking script cannot index into.
    return go.Scatter(x=df[x].tolist(), y=df[y].tolist(), customdata=df["student"].tolist(), mode="markers",
                      hovertemplate=hover,
                      marker=dict(size=10, color=POINT, opacity=0.85, line=dict(color=SURFACE, width=1.5)))


# --- tables --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

def change(v):
    if not isinstance(v, str) or not v:
        return ""
    if v == "=":
        return '<span class="muted">=</span>'
    if v == "new":
        return '<span class="pill">new</span>'
    return f'<span class="{"up" if v.startswith("↑") else "down"}">{v}</span>'


def percent(v):
    if pd.isna(v):
        return ""
    tone = "up" if v < -0.5 else "down" if v > 0.5 else "muted"
    return f'<span class="{tone}">{v:+.0f}%</span>'.replace("-", "−")


COLUMNS = [
    ("place", "#", "place", lambda v: f"{int(v)}", "Place by score; tied scores share a place"),
    ("student", "Student", "txt", html.escape, None),
    ("RMSE", "RMSE", "", lambda v: f"{v:.1f}", "Root mean squared error. Lower is better."),
    ("MAPE", "MAPE", "", lambda v: f"{v:.1f}%", "Mean absolute percentage error. Lower is better."),
    ("Winkler", "Winkler", "", lambda v: f"{v:.0f}",
     "Width of the 95% interval, plus 40 times the distance to every value outside it. Lower is better."),
    ("coverage", "Coverage", "", lambda v: f"{v:.0%}", "Share of hours inside the 95% interval; 95% is the target."),
    ("score", "Score", "", lambda v: f"{v:.1f}",
     "0.3 × RMSE place + 0.3 × MAPE place + 0.4 × Winkler place. Lower is better."),
]


def sort_value(key, v) -> str:
    # What a click on the column header sorts by; blank sorts last.
    if key == "student" or key == "stage":
        return html.escape(str(v)).lower()
    if key == "since_last":
        if not isinstance(v, str) or not v[:1] in "↑↓=":
            return ""
        return "0" if v == "=" else (v[1:] if v[0] == "↑" else f"-{v[1:]}")
    return "" if pd.isna(v) else f"{float(v):.6g}"


def board_table(board: pd.DataFrame, table_id: str, plot_id: str, extra=()) -> str:
    # A student tied with the benchmark has not beaten it, so the benchmark goes first among equal scores:
    # the rows above it are then exactly the students ahead of it.
    board = (board.assign(_b=board["student"].ne(BENCHMARK))
             .sort_values(["score", "_b"], kind="stable").drop(columns="_b"))
    cols = COLUMNS + list(extra)
    # Lower is better for every metric; for the change column, up is better, so it sorts largest first.
    head = "".join(
        f'<th class="{cls}" data-sort="{"text" if key in ("student", "stage") else "num"}"'
        f' data-first="{"desc" if key == "since_last" else "asc"}" aria-sort="none"'
        + (f' title="{html.escape(tip)}"' if tip else "") + f">{name}</th>"
        for key, name, cls, _, tip in cols)
    rows = []
    for _, r in board.iterrows():
        cells = "".join(f'<td class="{cls}" data-v="{sort_value(key, r[key])}">{fmt(r[key])}</td>'
                        for key, _, cls, fmt, _ in cols)
        if r["student"] == BENCHMARK:
            rows.append(f'<tr class="bench" title="The benchmark: seasonal naive, the last day twice">{cells}</tr>')
        else:
            rows.append(f'<tr class="row" tabindex="0" data-key="{html.escape(r["student"])}">{cells}</tr>')
    return (f'<input class="find" type="search" placeholder="Find a student" aria-label="Find a student" '
            f'data-table="{table_id}">'
            f'<table class="lb" id="{table_id}" data-plot="{plot_id}"><thead><tr>{head}</tr></thead>'
            f'<tbody>{"".join(rows)}</tbody></table>')


def stats(*items) -> HTML:
    return HTML('<div class="stats">' + "".join(
        f'<span class="stat"><span class="label">{label}</span><span class="value">{value}</span></span>'
        for label, value in items) + "</div>")


# --- data ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

public = pd.read_csv(BOARD / "public.csv")
meta = json.loads((BOARD / "public.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
public_bench = public.set_index("student").loc[BENCHMARK]
public_students = public[public["student"] != BENCHMARK]
updated = datetime.strptime(meta["updated"], "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M")

if REVEAL:
    private = pd.read_csv(BOARD / "private.csv")
    truth = pd.read_csv(PROJECT / "truth.csv", parse_dates=["ds"])
    history = pd.read_csv(PROJECT / "moodle" / "train.csv", parse_dates=["ds"]).tail(48)
    snaive = pd.read_csv(BOARD / "snaive.csv", parse_dates=["ds"])
    stages = {s: pd.read_csv(BOARD / f"{s}.csv") for s in ("session1", "final")}
    forecasts = pd.concat([pd.read_csv(BOARD / f"{s}_forecasts.csv", parse_dates=["ds"]) for s in stages])
    students = private[private["student"] != BENCHMARK]
    bench = private.set_index("student").loc[BENCHMARK]
    counted = forecasts.merge(students[["student", "stage"]], on=["student", "stage"])
    split = truth["ds"].iloc[len(truth) // 2]
    # The group forecast: hour by hour, the mean of the ranked files that beat the benchmark. Only that
    # flag is read from points.csv; the points themselves stay out of the page.
    points = pd.read_csv(BOARD / "points.csv")
    members = points.loc[points["beats_benchmark"] == True, "student"]  # noqa: E712, the column holds blanks
    BANDS = ["forecast", "lower_95", "upper_95"]
    group = counted[counted["student"].isin(members)].groupby("ds", as_index=False)[BANDS].mean()
    everyone = counted.groupby("ds", as_index=False)[BANDS].mean()


# --- charts --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

def public_scatter():
    hover = "<b>%{customdata}</b><br>RMSE %{x:.1f}<br>Winkler %{y:.0f}<extra></extra>"
    bx, by = public_bench["RMSE"], public_bench["Winkler"]
    fig = go.Figure([students_trace(public_students, "RMSE", "Winkler", hover)])
    fig.add_trace(go.Scatter(x=[bx], y=[by], mode="markers+text", text=["benchmark"], textposition="middle right",
                             textfont=dict(color=INK, size=12), hoverinfo="skip",
                             marker=dict(symbol="diamond", size=11, color=INK, line=dict(color=SURFACE, width=2))))
    fig.add_trace(pick_trace(hover))
    for kind, v in (("x", bx), ("y", by)):
        line = dict(type="line", line=dict(color=RULE, width=1), layer="below")
        fig.add_shape(**line, **({"x0": v, "x1": v, "yref": "paper", "y0": 0, "y1": 1} if kind == "x"
                                 else {"y0": v, "y1": v, "xref": "paper", "x0": 0, "x1": 1}))
    xs, ys = public["RMSE"], public["Winkler"]
    return (look(fig)
            .update_xaxes(type="log", title_text="RMSE, point error (log scale)", tickvals=nice_ticks(xs))
            .update_yaxes(type="log", title_text="Winkler, interval score (log scale)", tickvals=nice_ticks(ys)))


def private_scatter(both):
    hover = "<b>%{customdata}</b><br>public place %{x}<br>private place %{y}<extra></extra>"
    top = int(both[["public place", "place"]].to_numpy().max()) + 1
    ticks = [1] + list(range(5, top + 1, 5))
    fig = go.Figure([students_trace(both, "public place", "place", hover)])
    fig.add_shape(type="line", x0=0.5, y0=0.5, x1=top, y1=top, line=dict(color=RULE, width=1), layer="below")
    fig.add_trace(pick_trace(hover))
    return (look(fig)
            .update_xaxes(autorange="reversed", title_text="Place on the first 24 hours", tickvals=ticks)
            .update_yaxes(autorange="reversed", title_text="Place on the last 24 hours", tickvals=ticks))


def public_vs_private():
    # The public place of the very file that was ranked, so both places describe the same forecast.
    both = pd.concat(stages.values()).merge(students[["student", "stage", "place"]], on=["student", "stage"])
    both["public place"] = sum(w * both[f"public_{k}"].rank(method="min") for k, w in WEIGHTS.items()) \
        .rank(method="min").astype(int)
    return both


def split_marks(fig):
    fig.add_shape(type="line", x0=split, x1=split, yref="paper", y0=0, y1=1, line=dict(color=RULE, width=1))
    for text, anchor in (("first 24 hours (public)", "right"), ("last 24 hours (private)", "left")):
        fig.add_annotation(x=split, y=1, yref="paper", text=text, showarrow=False, xanchor=anchor,
                           xshift=-6 if anchor == "right" else 6, yanchor="bottom", font=dict(color=MUTED, size=12))
    return fig


def all_forecasts():
    fig = go.Figure()
    fig.add_trace(go.Scatter(x=history["ds"], y=history["y"], name="history", line=dict(color=INK2, width=1),
                             hovertemplate="%{y:.0f}"))
    xs, ys = [], []
    for who in students["student"]:
        fc = counted[counted["student"] == who]
        xs += list(fc["ds"]) + [None]
        ys += list(fc["forecast"]) + [None]
    fig.add_trace(go.Scatter(x=xs, y=ys, name="every student", hoverinfo="skip", connectgaps=False,
                             line=dict(color=RULE, width=1)))
    fig.add_trace(go.Scatter(x=snaive["ds"], y=snaive["forecast"], name="benchmark",
                             line=dict(color=INK2, width=1.5, dash="dash"), hovertemplate="%{y:.0f}"))
    fig.add_trace(go.Scatter(x=truth["ds"], y=truth["y"], name="actual", line=dict(color=INK, width=2.5),
                             hovertemplate="%{y:.0f}"))
    fig.add_trace(go.Scatter(x=[], y=[], name="", meta="pick", line=dict(color=ACCENT, width=2.5),
                             hovertemplate="%{y:.0f}"))
    return split_marks(look(fig, hovermode="x unified", margin=dict(l=60, r=20, t=30, b=40))
                       .update_yaxes(title_text="Generation", rangemode="tozero"))


def winner_interval():
    fig = go.Figure()
    band = lambda f, lo, hi: (pd.concat([f["ds"], f["ds"][::-1]]), pd.concat([f[hi], f[lo][::-1]]))
    x, y = band(snaive, "lower_95", "upper_95")
    fig.add_trace(go.Scatter(x=x, y=y, fill="toself", fillcolor="rgba(137,135,129,0.16)", line=dict(width=0),
                             name="benchmark, 95% interval", hoverinfo="skip"))
    fig.add_trace(go.Scatter(x=[], y=[], meta="pick-band", fill="toself", fillcolor="rgba(28,92,171,0.16)",
                             line=dict(width=0), name="", hoverinfo="skip"))
    fig.add_trace(go.Scatter(x=snaive["ds"], y=snaive["forecast"], name="benchmark",
                             line=dict(color=INK2, width=1.5, dash="dash"), hovertemplate="%{y:.0f}"))
    fig.add_trace(go.Scatter(x=[], y=[], meta="pick", name="", line=dict(color=ACCENT, width=2.5),
                             hovertemplate="%{y:.0f}"))
    fig.add_trace(go.Scatter(x=truth["ds"], y=truth["y"], name="actual", line=dict(color=INK, width=2.5),
                             hovertemplate="%{y:.0f}"))
    return split_marks(look(fig, hovermode="x unified", margin=dict(l=60, r=20, t=30, b=40))
                       .update_yaxes(title_text="Generation", rangemode="tozero"))


def forecast_data() -> str:
    data = {who: {"ds": f["ds"].dt.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M").tolist(), "forecast": f["forecast"].round(2).tolist(),
                  "lower": f["lower_95"].round(2).tolist(), "upper": f["upper_95"].round(2).tolist()}
            for who, f in counted.groupby("student")}
    return f"<script>window.MATH840_FORECASTS = {json.dumps(data, ensure_ascii=False)};</script>"


def picker() -> str:
    options = "".join(f'<option value="{html.escape(s)}">{int(p)}. {html.escape(s)}</option>'
                      for s, p in zip(students["student"], students["place"]))
    return (f'<label class="pickrow">Highlight a student<select class="pick" aria-label="Highlight a student">'
            f'{options}</select></label>')


def last_day_scores(fc, name) -> dict:
    # The scorer's metrics on the last 24 hours, for a forecast that is not a student's file.
    last = truth.iloc[len(truth) // 2:].merge(fc, on="ds")
    y, f, lo, hi = (last[c].to_numpy(float) for c in ["y", *BANDS])
    return {"student": name, "RMSE": float(np.sqrt(np.mean((y - f) ** 2))),
            "MAPE": float(np.mean(np.abs((y - f) / y)) * 100),
            "Winkler": float(np.mean(hi - lo + 40 * np.maximum(lo - y, 0) + 40 * np.maximum(y - hi, 0))),
            "coverage": float(np.mean((y >= lo) & (y <= hi)))}


def group_place(row) -> int:
    # Where the group forecast would stand in the private table. It is not added to the table itself.
    pool = pd.concat([private, pd.DataFrame([row])], ignore_index=True)
    score = sum(w * pool[k].rank(method="min") for k, w in WEIGHTS.items())
    return int(score.rank(method="min").iloc[-1])


def member_bootstrap() -> dict:
    # Resample the students and take the 95% band of the group mean. This measures how sure we are of the
    # average, not where the actual value lands, which is why the page does not use it as the interval.
    wide = counted[counted["student"].isin(members)].pivot(index="ds", columns="student", values="forecast")
    pick = np.random.default_rng(840).integers(0, wide.shape[1], (4000, wide.shape[1]))
    means = wide.to_numpy()[:, pick].mean(axis=2)
    band = pd.DataFrame({"ds": wide.index, "forecast": means.mean(axis=1),
                         "lower_95": np.quantile(means, 0.025, axis=1),
                         "upper_95": np.quantile(means, 0.975, axis=1)})
    return {**last_day_scores(band, "bootstrap"), "width": float((band["upper_95"] - band["lower_95"]).tail(24).mean())}


def group_chart():
    fig = go.Figure()
    x = pd.concat([group["ds"], group["ds"][::-1]])
    fig.add_trace(go.Scatter(x=x, y=pd.concat([group["upper_95"], group["lower_95"][::-1]]), fill="toself",
                             fillcolor="rgba(28,92,171,0.16)", line=dict(width=0), name="95% interval",
                             hoverinfo="skip"))
    fig.add_trace(go.Scatter(x=snaive["ds"], y=snaive["forecast"], name="benchmark",
                             line=dict(color=INK2, width=1.5, dash="dash"), hovertemplate="%{y:.0f}"))
    fig.add_trace(go.Scatter(x=group["ds"], y=group["forecast"], name="group forecast",
                             line=dict(color=ACCENT, width=2.5), hovertemplate="%{y:.0f}"))
    fig.add_trace(go.Scatter(x=truth["ds"], y=truth["y"], name="actual", line=dict(color=INK, width=2.5),
                             hovertemplate="%{y:.0f}"))
    return split_marks(look(fig, hovermode="x unified", margin=dict(l=60, r=20, t=30, b=40))
                       .update_yaxes(title_text="Generation", rangemode="tozero"))


def group_table(row) -> str:
    # Lower is better for every metric here, so the header sorting works as on the leaderboards.
    top = students.iloc[0]
    middle = students[["RMSE", "MAPE", "Winkler", "coverage"]].median().to_dict()
    entries = [row, {**top[["RMSE", "MAPE", "Winkler", "coverage"]].to_dict(), "student": f"First place: {top['student']}"},
               {**middle, "student": "Median student"},
               {**bench[["RMSE", "MAPE", "Winkler", "coverage"]].to_dict(), "student": BENCHMARK}]
    cols = [c for c in COLUMNS if c[0] not in ("place", "score")]
    head = "".join(f'<th class="{cls}" data-sort="{"text" if key == "student" else "num"}" data-first="asc" '
                   f'aria-sort="none"' + (f' title="{html.escape(tip)}"' if tip else "") + f">{name}</th>"
                   for key, name, cls, _, tip in cols)
    body = "".join(
        ('<tr class="bench">' if e["student"] == BENCHMARK else "<tr>")
        + "".join(f'<td class="{cls}" data-v="{sort_value(key, e[key])}">{fmt(e[key])}</td>'
                  for key, _, cls, fmt, _ in cols) + "</tr>"
        for e in entries)
    return f'<table class="lb" id="group-table"><thead><tr>{head}</tr></thead><tbody>{body}</tbody></table>'


def session1_vs_final():
    pair = (stages["session1"].query("valid").set_index("student")[["private_RMSE"]]
            .join(stages["final"].query("valid").set_index("student")[["private_RMSE"]],
                  lsuffix="_s1", rsuffix="_final", how="inner").reset_index())
    hi = float(pair[["private_RMSE_s1", "private_RMSE_final"]].to_numpy().max()) * 1.08 if len(pair) else 1
    hover = "<b>%{customdata}</b><br>Session 1 file %{x:.1f}<br>final file %{y:.1f}<extra></extra>"
    fig = go.Figure([students_trace(pair, "private_RMSE_s1", "private_RMSE_final", hover)])
    fig.add_shape(type="line", x0=0, y0=0, x1=hi, y1=hi, line=dict(color=RULE, width=1), layer="below")
    for kind in ("x", "y"):
        v = bench["RMSE"]
        fig.add_shape(type="line", line=dict(color=INK2, width=1, dash="dot"), layer="below",
                      **({"x0": v, "x1": v, "y0": 0, "y1": hi} if kind == "x" else {"y0": v, "y1": v, "x0": 0, "x1": hi}))
    fig.add_annotation(x=hi, y=bench["RMSE"], text="benchmark", showarrow=False, xanchor="right", xshift=-4,
                       yanchor="bottom", font=dict(color=INK2, size=12))
    # Name the three biggest improvements; the tooltip carries the rest.
    pair["gain"] = pair["private_RMSE_s1"] - pair["private_RMSE_final"]
    for _, r in pair.nlargest(3, "gain").query("gain > 0").iterrows():
        fig.add_annotation(x=r["private_RMSE_s1"], y=r["private_RMSE_final"], text=html.escape(r["student"]),
                           showarrow=False, yshift=12, font=dict(color=INK, size=12))
    return (look(fig).update_xaxes(range=[0, hi], title_text="RMSE on the last 24 hours, Session 1 file")
                     .update_yaxes(range=[0, hi], title_text="RMSE on the last 24 hours, final file"))
```

# Public leaderboard

## Row {height="104px"}

```{python}
ahead = int((public_students["score"] < public_bench["score"]).sum())
stats(("On the leaderboard", f"{len(public_students)} <small>students</small>"),
      ("Above the benchmark in the table", f"{ahead} <small>of {len(public_students)}</small>"),
      ("Updated", f"{updated.day} Nov, {updated:%H:%M}"),
      ("Next update", "None, this is the last" if REVEAL else NEXT.get(meta["stage"], "")))
```

## Row

### Column {width=55%}

```{python}
#| title: "First 24 hidden hours"
HTML(board_table(public, "public-table", "public-scatter", extra=[
    ("since_last", "Since last", "", change, "Change in place since the previous table"),
    ("vs_session1", "vs Session 1", "", percent,
     "RMSE of your latest file against your Session 1 file, same 24 hours. Negative means the error went down."),
]))
```

### Column {width=45%}

```{python}
#| title: "Point error against interval score"
both_better = int(((public_students["RMSE"] < public_bench["RMSE"])
                   & (public_students["Winkler"] < public_bench["Winkler"])).sum())
show(public_scatter(), "public-scatter",
     f'<p class="sub">Lower and to the left is better. The lines go through the benchmark; {both_better} '
     f'students beat it on both scores. Hover a row in the table to find a student here.</p>')
```

::: {.card title="How to read this" .note height="34%"}
Each forecast is scored on the first 24 of the 48 hidden hours, with each student's latest valid file
before the update. Hover a column name for what it measures; click it to sort by it, and
click *#* to go back to the ranking.

*Since last* and *vs Session 1* are for reference and do not affect points. *Since last* compares with the
previous table (for the first update, with Session 1). *vs Session 1* is blank until you send a new file.

The final ranking is computed on the last 24 hours, so a place there can differ from a place here.
:::

# Private leaderboard

## Row {height="104px"}

```{python}
stats(("Ranked", f"{len(students)} <small>students</small>" if REVEAL else "6 Nov"),
      # Beating it means a lower RMSE or a better combined score, either one (the rule from 5 Nov).
      ("Beat the benchmark: lower RMSE or better score",
       f"{int(((students['RMSE'] < bench['RMSE']) | (students['score'] < bench['score'])).sum())} "
       f"<small>of {len(students)}</small>" if REVEAL else "6 Nov"),
      ("First place", html.escape(students.iloc[0]["student"]) if REVEAL else "6 Nov"))
```

# Group forecast

## Row {height="104px"}

```{python}
if REVEAL:
    group_row = last_day_scores(group, "Group forecast")
    all_row = last_day_scores(everyone, "All students")
    boot = member_bootstrap()
stats(("Forecasts combined", f"{len(members)} <small>of {len(students)}</small>" if REVEAL else "6 Nov"),
      ("RMSE on the last 24 hours, against the benchmark",
       f"{group_row['RMSE'] / bench['RMSE'] - 1:+.0%}".replace("-", "−") if REVEAL else "6 Nov"),
      ("Place it would take in the private table",
       f"{group_place(group_row)} <small>of {len(private) + 1}</small>" if REVEAL else "6 Nov"))
```

### Column {width=38%}

```{python}
#| title: "Last 24 hours"
HTML(group_table(group_row)) if REVEAL else WAIT
```

```{python}
#| title: "How it was built"
HTML(f'''<div class="note">
<p>Each hour's forecast is the mean of the {len(members)} ranked files that beat the benchmark. The lower
bound is the mean of their lower bounds, and the upper bound the mean of their upper bounds. It is not in
the ranking and earns no points.</p>
<p>A bootstrap over students would give the wrong band here. It shows how sure we are of the average, not
where the actual value lands: on the last 24 hours that band was {boot["width"]:.0f} wide on average and
held {boot["coverage"]:.0%} of the hours. The averaged bounds were {(group["upper_95"] - group["lower_95"]).tail(24).mean():.0f}
wide and held {group_row["coverage"]:.0%}.</p>
<p>These files were chosen on the same hours that score them, which flatters the result. The mean of all
{len(students)} files, with nothing left out, has an RMSE of {all_row["RMSE"]:.1f} against {group_row["RMSE"]:.1f}.</p>
</div>''') if REVEAL else WAIT
```
